hero.title: Make AI truly yours
hero.lead: Bring models, memory, and permissions back to your computer. One open-source personal AI foundation for lightweight apps and companions that follow you across them.
hero.availability: Free & open core · Mac (Apple silicon) & Windows · Beta
hero.metaDescription: Bring models, memory, and permissions back to your computer. Nimi is an open-source, local-first personal AI foundation for lightweight apps and cross-app companions.
hero.continuitySampleText: Remind me at 8 PM to write up those mineral-pigment notes, starting with the soot-glaze step.
hero.continuitySampleReply: Noted—8 PM tonight, starting with the mineral-pigment mix for the soot under the eaves. Pick this back up with me anytime.
hero.guideStep2Title: Send a line to sync to Home
hero.guideDoneText: Chat synced — explore Nimi Home freely
runtime.title: When intelligence lives in your base, screens are just viewports
runtime.description: One AI core runs on your computer—web and mobile apps you approve connect straight back to it.
runtime.caption: Remote web and mobile links require approval in Nimi first. Mobile apps are not yet in app stores; start by installing Nimi on your computer.
experience.title: Less setup, transparent memory, private by design
experience.reply: Switch to an app that suits the task and pick up where you left off.
experience.memorySeed: I’d like to keep talking about light and shadow in brick art next time.
experience.modelsTitle: Set up AI once, use it everywhere
experience.modelsBody: Stop downloading gigabytes of models or pasting keys into every app. Configure local or cloud AI once in Nimi Home and every tool shares it.
experience.modelsDataNote: Cloud requests send only what is needed for that single prompt.
experience.switchModels: Switch local or cloud model preview
experience.memoryTitle: See and edit everything it remembers
experience.memoryBody: Memories live on your computer with a link to the exact chat—fix a detail or erase it with a click.
experience.continuityTitle: Every app stays in its own drawer
experience.continuityBody: Research, family journals, and video tools share one AI setup while keeping each app’s files strictly separated.
agents.title: More than a chat window: companions that live on your computer
agents.originTitle: Rich backstories and warm, real voices
agents.originBody: Listen first, pick someone you click with, and invite them onto your computer—private chats stay local.
agents.utopiaTitle: Living habitat scrolls—drop in anytime, zero spam
agents.utopiaBody: Open NimiUtopia to watch companions stroll, tune tides and weather, or relocate across themed scrolls and custom .utopia packs—quiet by default, with instant handoff to Zhiyu.
agents.embodimentTitle: Seamless in chat, respectful inside tools
agents.embodimentBody: Picks up last night’s thread in Zhiyu and Home, yet never reads private chats when helping inside a tool.
portals.title: Explore more of Nimi
portals.homeBody: Explore eight illustrated worlds, listen to character voices, and try the quiet-hours switch and memory drawer.
portals.appsBody: Preview 24 open-source apps—from companion habitats to research, video translation, and diagramming—in your browser.
portals.platformTitle: Why AI Belongs in Your Own Foundation
portals.platformBody: See how Nimi pulls compute, memory, and identity out of isolated apps into a foundation you own.
portals.developersTitle: Ship AI Apps Without Model Bloat
portals.developersBody: Create a fresh app or adapt an open-source favorite onto Nimi with a few lines of TypeScript.
worlds.title: Step into rich worlds and meet voiced characters
worlds.body: Browse their stories and tap to hear their real voices.
worlds.audioError: Could not play the voice sample. Please try again.
showcase.title: Explore AI apps
showcase.body: Preview the apps and see what they can do.
integrations.title: Clear app permissions and everyday channels
integrations.body: Every app keeps its own private folder—AI access, knowledge sources, and chat channels work only when you say yes.
integrations.app: Separate folders per app, zero overreach
integrations.appScope: Each app states up front what it needs; anything outside your approval is blocked automatically.
integrations.partitionNote: Dedicated local folder per app · Private files never cross over
integrations.mcp: Connect external knowledge on your terms
integrations.mcpScope: Add a reference source once in Nimi Home and choose which apps may read it.
integrations.messagingScope: Connect WeChat, Feishu, QQ, or Telegram in one place and toggle access anytime.
integrations.footnote: Nimi Home holds your account keys centrally so individual apps never see raw secrets.
builder.title: Ship a lightweight AI app in a few lines of code
builder.body: Plug into ready-made AI capabilities and UI components without bundling gigabytes of model runtimes.
